snippet.title: Baldur’s Gate 3 Accolades Trailer
snippet.description:
Now…it is time for you to join the others, and complete our destiny.

Winner of multiple Game Of The Year Awards, Baldur’s Gate 3 is out now on Xbox Series X|S, joining PlayStation 5 and PC players.

Get Baldur’s Gate 3 now: larian.club/x_BG3_PartyTime
